W.note: Tight 4-column grid with single-line add and stepper controls and clear status feedback, though long product names truncate on desktop and the blue accent reads a little generic.

X.note: Most complete shopping flow with search, filters, sort, a cart drawer with totals and checkout, but initials placeholder tiles, ratings and tags add clutter and the cards are tall.

Y.note: Restrained outlined buttons and clear cart drawer, but emoji product art looks dated and inconsistent, cards are roomy, and the mobile filter chips wrap into an awkward stack.

Z.note: Dense and restrained with consistent hand-drawn product art and a clean mobile layout, but desktop button labels and stepper counts wrap awkwardly and there is no cart review or checkout.
